The Moon dives into Pisces and goes all soft-focus.

The Moon slips into Pisces today, trines Venus around lunchtime and squares Uranus this evening. Swipe for Aries, Leo and Sagittarius, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Fire friend. 🌙
